configurations.name: nexus-service
runtimeArgs: cd '../Guidance Nexus/guidance-nexus/services/analysis' && NEXUS_TOKEN=dev-token-not-a-secret-01 PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m nexus_analysis --port 8765 --data-dir .devdata

configurations.name: nexus-ui
runtimeArgs: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.5/bin:$PATH && cd '../Guidance Nexus/guidance-nexus/apps/desktop' && VITE_NEXUS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 VITE_NEXUS_TOKEN=dev-token-not-a-secret-01 npm run dev
